'''Relay Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|This relay can be used to transmit power to other facilities within an 80-meter radius.
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also lets it supply power to other Endfield facilities within a small area.|The Relay Tower is one of the most expensive AIC facilities to construct. Its overall design is based on the PAC.}}
==Usage==
This relay can be used to transmit power to other facilities within an 80-meter radius.
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also lets it supply power to other Endfield facilities within a small area.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Power Relay]]
